RESULT [attribution]: The influence of an individual training sample is often overshadowed by noise from model initialisation and SGD batch composition, with initialisation the larger source. Pairs whose influence holds up across that noise exist but are rare.
US [attribution]: This is a design constraint for the rollback analyser. Per-image influence scores from a single YOLO run (TracIn/TRAK/IF) should not be the evidence for rolling a batch back. Work at batch level across several seeds, and act only on attributions that keep their sign across seeds.
